coverage_assessment: Bounded English and Persian open-web discovery: 12 batched actions (48 query strings) and 367 ordered result headers, focused on pensioners, labor, agriculture, energy/transport, Homa/HEPCO and Saravan/Sistan-Baluchistan. Event-level body verification is incomplete after fresh receipt scans and immediate full-input hash checks encountered concurrent corpus changes. Search coverage is not exhaustive; LexisNexis and systematic provincial-archive access were not established. Search-only leads are pending evidence; this is not evidence that no other events occurred.
